content_fields.title: Test server-side enforcement of authorization
content_fields.description: Enforce the role requirement server side on the role-update route instead of relying on a single negative check.
content_fields.finding: The only server-side check rejects the Chef role; every other role change is applied to any username without verifying the caller's privileges.
content_fields.current_code:
async def update_user_role(
    user: UserRoleUpdate,
    current_user: Annotated[models.User, Depends(get_current_user)],
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    if user.role == models.UserRole.CHEF.value:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Only Chef is authorized to add Chef role!",
        )

    db_user = update_user(db, user.username, user)
    return current_user

criteria: The route rejects any caller who is not a chef, before inspecting the body.
The set of assignable roles is an explicit allow-list.
A customer calling the route receives 403.
